content.title: Nidec Shares Slide After Widening Accounting Scandal Hurts Trust
content.summary: The latest revelations emerged from an external probe that began earlier this month when Nidec found evidence of systemic accounting problems.  On Friday, it said in a financial report — submitted after a three-month delay — that it had unearthed new problems.  Nidec’s stock fell as much as 4.8% early on Monday, which was also an ex-dividend date for the company.

content.title: Carlyle in white knight talks with Makino, say sources, as Nidec takeover battle heats up
content.summary: Private equity giant Carlyle is in talks with Japan's Makino Milling Machine as a potential white knight buyer to counter a $1.81 billion hostile takeover bid from Nidec, four people familiar with the matter said.  The battle to take the machine tool manufacturer private is heating up, with Nidec launching its tender offer for 11,000 yen ($77.30) per share on April 4 and Makino's board approving a "poison pill" takeover defence last week.
